jobs.title: Business Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
We believe a story can change what a person can see: not by arguing, but by showing them something true they didn’t have words for. Dream Three is a story studio built to deliver best\-in\-class, genre\-spanning narratives across mediums, including film and series, theater and live events, publishing and music, and digital and immersive. If you’re looking for a team that takes big creative swings and doesn’t settle for less than excellent, keep reading.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**
=================


We believe in the power of story. Dream Three is a multi\-platform story studio built to deliver best\-in\-class, genre\-spanning narratives across media, including film and series, theater and live events, publishing and music, and digital and immersive. If you’re looking for a team that takes bold, creative swings and doesn’t settle for less than excellent, keep reading.


We’re hiring an Operations Coordinator to keep business operations running smoothly and to provide executive support to our CEO and leadership by coordinating people, paperwork, and follow\-through on creative projects and talent engagements. You’ll step into established workflows, receive clear direction, and have room to improve processes as you build ownership. The role starts part\-time, with potential for expanded hours and broader operational responsibility.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
===========================

* Deadlines, decisions, and next steps are clear; routine work reaches completion without repeated prompting.
* Agreements, financial paperwork, schedules, and records are accurate, organized, and ready for review.
* You resolve routine issues, communicate early when priorities conflict, and protect leadership’s time.

**WHO YOU ARE**
===============

* You enjoy making systems work. You are precise, resourceful, discreet, and comfortable following up with people at every level.
* You close loops. You don’t confuse sending a reminder with resolving an issue.
* You turn ambiguity into clarity by implementing workable plans without creating unnecessary bureaucratic fiction.
* You stay calm when priorities change and take pride in making ambitious creative work possible.
* You welcome direct feedback, take responsibility for your work, and stay effective when deadlines and priorities shift.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
========================

* **Operations \+ Projects:** Maintain tasks, deadlines, and trackers; translate decisions into assigned actions and coordinate administrative handoffs with project teams and partners.
* **Executive Support:** Coordinate scheduling, meeting preparation, designated correspondence, and approved business travel; organize decisions and follow\-up for the CEO.
* **Financial Administration:** Collect and check invoices, receipts, and vendor documents; route approvals, maintain status records, and follow up with the bookkeeper and appropriate partners.
* **Contracts \+ Bookings:** Prepare deal memos and booking documents from approved templates and confirmed terms; coordinate review, signatures, deadlines, and booking logistics.
* **Systems \+ Documentation:** Keep assigned records and instructions current, run established workflows, and propose practical improvements.

**ROLE REQUIREMENTS**
=====================

* Relevant experience in operations, project coordination, executive support, or business administration—typically 1–3 years; equivalent practical experience is welcome.
* Evidence of accurate follow\-through, professional writing, sound judgment, and ownership of recurring work.
* Comfort with spreadsheets, document preparation, task tracking, and learning new systems. Entertainment\-specific processes can be learned; attention to detail and dependability are essential.

**TOOLS YOU’LL USE**
====================


Asana, Airtable, Slack, Dropbox, Word/Excel, DocuSign, and designated business\-administration tools. Experience with comparable platforms is welcome.

**PLUSES**
==========


Entertainment or talent\-representation experience; familiarity with contracts, deal memos, financial paperwork, multiple business entities, or process documentation.

**ADDITIONAL DETAILS**
======================

* **Employment:** Part\-time, hourly, nonexempt W\-2 employee.
* **Pay:** $25–$35/hour overall. Starting pay reflects demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and work location.
* **Hours:** Initially \~25 hours per week during standard business hours, M\-F 10am \- 6pm ET. May require some evenings \+ weekends as projects and business needs require.
* **Location \+ Travel:** Remote (U.S.) and Hybrid (NYC/LA) candidates are welcome. Occasional business travel may be required.
* **Start Date:** As soon as mutually agreed; reasonable notice periods accommodated.
* **Benefits \+ Support:** Reimbursement for preapproved education relevant to your role.
* **Application:** Apply through Ashby with your résumé and one brief example of a recurring operational workflow you personally owned. No cover letter is required.


If this role feels like a stretch in all the right ways, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us how your skills, experience, and unique point of view can level up this team and the stories we’re bringing into the world.


Dream Three is an equal opportunity employer. We value a wide range of backgrounds, identities, and perspectives, and strongly encourage candidates from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator - Professional Channel
jobs.description:
Dermalogica is so much more than just a skincare brand: we are industry leaders driven by innovation, education, and a passion for results. With distribution in over 80 countries and the backing of Unilever, we combine entrepreneurial spirit with cutting\-edge resources to bring top\-tier skincare to professionals and consumers alike. Bolstered by our International Dermal Institute – the apex of post\-graduate skin and body therapy training – we are on an exhilarating journey of expansion. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment and are eager to make an impact, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!


**What You Will Do**


We are seeking an impactful **Marketing Coordinator** who will play a vital role in supporting all marketing efforts for Dermalogica’s Professional Channel. You will contribute and enhance existing programs while assisting with the development of new initiatives aligned with company goals. The ideal candidate will have experience in a wide range of marketing functions, including communications, advertising, branding, digital, and social media. The Marketing Coordinator must be an organized multitasker, able to handle many diverse projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Communicate campaign objectives, timelines, and deliverables to field team, providing detailed instructions for effective usage and promotion.
* Manage assets and collaterals using the Exfluential platform to ensure organized and accessible marketing materials.
* Manage the email communication calendar by collaborating with all relevant teams using Klaviyo platform to ensure timely and cohesive messaging.
* Oversee the inventory and directory of sales support materials, ensuring all resources are up\-to\-date and coordinate the creation of new materials as necessary.
* Assist in the ongoing updates and maintenance of the company website to ensure content accuracy and freshness.
* Facilitate monthly marketing initiatives, including promotions, product launches, and programs by creating assets, coordinating internal and external communications, managing inventory, and handling set up requirements.
* Organize and support trade shows, conferences, corporate events and meetings by managing logistical requirements, developing schedules, and coordinating team assignments.
* Compile market research, competitor analyses, campaign results, and consumer trends.
* Contribute to creative brainstorming sessions for promotions, including special offers and promotional merchandise, to enhance marketing efforts.
* Provide essential administrative support, including budget management, invoicing, and creative brief input.

**Key Collaborators:**


* Senior Marketing Manager, Professional Channel
* Associate Marketing Manager, Professional Channel
* Sales Team
* Sales Operations Team
* Education Team
* Consumer Marketing Team

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**


* At least 1 to 2 years experience in a community management, social media, or influencer marketing role.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in marketing, advertising, or communications; affinity for the professional skincare audience strongly preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously within a fast\-paced environment, with a high degree of independence and resilience.
* Strong interpersonal skills; flexible and adaptable to change.
* Proactive self\-starter with a high degree of initiative and independent thinking.
* Strong project management skills; ability to think critically and creatively.
* Analytical, passionate, and innovative, with comfort using data to guide outreach.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively within a team; resourceful, creative problem solver.
* Positive attitude with an excitement for learning and openness to new experiences and challenges.
* Proficient use of Proficient in Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Word, Excel and related software skills
* Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), customer relationship management (CRM) tools, and email marketing platforms.
* Must be comfortable with hybrid schedule of 2\-3 days a week in the Carson office.

**Compensation and Benefits**


**The expected base hourly pay rate range is $24 to $26 per hour.** The exact base pay rate is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, and budget. This role is eligible for participation in our company bonus plan, rewarding personal performance and company results.


Dermalogica offers a comprehensive benefits package including health coverage, paid time off, and employee product benefits.


Ready to make a meaningful impact and advance your career with a global brand revolutionizing the skincare industry? Apply now and complete your online application. All applications will be reviewed, and our HR team will contact you if your skills align with the position.


*Dermalogica is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive culture where all employees are valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.*

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
NU Dental Aesthetics is seeking a creative, organized, and data\-driven **Social Media Manager** to help build and manage our growing presence across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and other relevant platforms.

We are a new, design\-focused dental practice in Huntington Beach specializing in aesthetic and preservation\-focused dentistry. This is an opportunity to help shape a distinctive brand from the beginning.

Responsibilities

* Develop and and maintain the social media strategy and content calendar
* Schedule and publish approved platform\-specific posts, Reels, Stories, Shorts, and videos
* Coordinate content with our founder, writer, videographer, editor, and designers
* Write or refine captions, hooks, titles, and calls to action
* Maintain a consistent brand voice and polished visual presence
* Monitor comments and messages, engage professionally, and route patient inquiries appropriately
* Track performance, prepare concise weekly reports, and recommend improvements
* Identify relevant trends, collaborations, and content opportunities
* Confirm that all content has the required approvals before publication

Who We’re Looking For

* Demonstrated social media management experience
* Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, and X
* Excellent writing, communication, organization, and project\-management skills
* Ability to interpret analytics and turn insights into action
* Strong aesthetic judgment and exceptional attention to detail
* Professional, dependable, adaptable, and receptive to feedback
* Comfortable managing multiple deadlines and collaborating with a creative team
* Experience with healthcare, dentistry, beauty, wellness, or premium consumer brands is preferred

—not required

* Basic design or video\-editing ability is a plus

Because NU is a healthcare practice, the ideal candidate must exercise excellent judgment around patient privacy, clinical information, media authorization, and professional communication. Clinical claims and patient content may only be published after approval.

Why Join NU?

* Help build a premium dental and aesthetic brand from the ground up
* Contribute ideas and influence the brand’s creative direction
* Work with distinctive content involving smile design, technology, artistry, patient education, and behind\-the\-scenes processes
* Join a modern practice that values quality, originality, integrity, and thoughtful execution
* Grow with the brand as our content operation expands

Pay: $28\.00 \- $38\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 8\.0 – 16\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
We founded Bild AI to tackle the mess that is blueprint reading, cost estimation, and permit applications in construction. Today we are the AI takeoff platform for Division 8: doors, frames, and hardware. Distributors across the US run their takeoffs on Bild AI and push them into Comsense, AVAware, eMullion, ProTech, and TOAD. Featured on Business Insider.

  

Our customers want to talk to us every week. That is the best signal a startup can get, and it is more than the founders and engineers can carry alone. You will be the first person at Bild AI whose whole job is making Division 8 estimators get over the training hump and become successful on the product.

  

You'll

* Own a book of Division 8 distributors and run their weekly calls
* Onboard and train estimators on Bild AI and Bildy, and get their takeoffs into Comsense, AVAware, eMullion, ProTech, TOAD, or Excel
* Travel a few times a month to sit next to estimators, run trainings, and map how their shop really works from drawings to ERP
* Turn what you hear into requirements the engineers ship the following week
* Watch account health, catch low usage early, and pull accounts back before they churn
* Figure out how customer success works at 50 and 100 customers: cohort trainings, office hours, videos, in\-product help. Whatever keeps the signal of a weekly call without 40 hours of meetings

  

We want

* 3\+ years in Division 8: estimating, detailing, project management, or inside sales
* Hands\-on use of at least one of Comsense, AVAware, eMullion, ProTech, or TOAD
* Read door schedules, hardware sets, and specs without help
* You're the person your coworkers already ask when the software does something weird, and you've trained new members of your team
* Hungry IC. You want to learn the whole industry, not manage a team. A lot of this job is listening
* Communicate with empathy and honesty. Tell us what makes you happy/unhappy
* Don't mind schlep. We are regularly knee\-deep in schlep

  

Bonus points (if any)

* DHI coursework, DHT, or AHC
* Have used Bild AI or another AI takeoff tool
* Have trained other estimators or new hires
* Are impact\-driven

  

Message with

* Why we're a fit
* The ERP you have fought with the most, and how you won
* Your favorite fruit (mine is Sitaphal)
* (Please keep it short)

  

Interview Process

* 15\-30 min intro
* 1\-2 hour interview
* 2\-3 day paid work trial with real customers

  

Logistics

* SF\-based or willing to relocate (we'll help)
* Travel 2\-4 trips a month
* Full time


Compensation Range: $70K \- $140K

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Business Development Representative to join our growing team! In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of expanding our client base, forging strategic partnerships, and driving revenue growth. Your enthusiasm for sales and business development will fuel your success as you identify new opportunities, nurture relationships, and close impactful deals. This position offers a fantastic chance to develop your skills in enterprise selling, strategic planning, and cross\-functional collaboration within a fast\-paced environment. If you're passionate about creating meaningful connections and thrive on achieving targets, this role is perfect for you!

**Duties**

* Prospect and qualify new business opportunities through targeted outreach and market research using CRM software such as Salesforce.
* Engage with potential clients via calls, emails, and meetings to understand their needs and present tailored solutions.
* Manage the entire sales cycle from initial contact to deal closing, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
* Collaborate closely with marketing teams to develop strategies that generate leads and increase brand awareness.
* Maintain accurate records of client interactions, pipeline status, and sales activities within CRM systems.
* Develop strategic plans to expand existing client relationships while identifying new markets for growth.
* Lead negotiations on proposals and contracts to secure mutually beneficial agreements that support long\-term partnerships.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in business development management or enterprise sales with a track record of successful deal closing.
* Proficiency in CRM software such as Salesforce and other CRM systems for managing customer relationships effectively.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office tools including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for reporting and presentations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to build rapport with clients across diverse industries.
* Demonstrated expertise in prospecting, sales negotiation, and strategic planning to achieve targets.
* Ability to collaborate across teams such as marketing, product management, and customer support for comprehensive business growth strategies.
* Experience in customer relationship management (CRM system proficiency), project management, and cross\-functional collaboration is highly desirable.

Join us as a Business Development Representative and be part of a vibrant team committed to driving innovation and growth! Your proactive approach and strategic mindset will help shape our future success while providing valuable solutions to our clients worldwide.

Pay: $55,135\.04 \- $66,399\.19 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Global Aid Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Flexport:**
-------------------



At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.



The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------



Flexport.org is the humanitarian arm of Flexport. We serve nonprofits, NGOs, and mission\-driven organizations that need to move impactful cargo reliably, often into some of the hardest environments to reach. As humanitarian and development needs keep climbing, the supply chain expertise our partners can count on matters more than ever.



You'll own some of Flexport.org's most complex and highest\-impact partner relationships. Your accounts span multiple shipping modes and trade lanes: ocean, air, trucking, and customs, and demand real supply chain fluency to navigate well. You won't just manage these relationships, you'll shape them. You bring a strategic point of view to every partner engagement, lead business reviews that drive real decisions, and connect the dots across Flexport's full product suite to help partners do more with what they have. You'll operate with full autonomy, hold a high bar on program growth and retention, and become someone junior teammates turn to for guidance.


**You Will**
------------


* Own end\-to\-end success for a portfolio of complex, multi\-modal Flexport.org partner accounts, including partners with significant program growth potential and high operational intensity.
* Lead RFP bids and contract renewals end\-to\-end.
* Serve as a true strategic partner to nonprofits, NGOs, and mission\-driven organizations, going deep on their supply chain operations to find where Flexport can cut cost, add capability, or move faster.
* Lead high\-impact business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) that go beyond reporting. Bring market context, multi\-modal insight, and recommendations tailored to each partner's mission and constraints.
* Drive expansion across Flexport's full product suite, consistently meeting or exceeding program growth and retention targets.
* Collaborate with Operations, Pricing, Legal, Trade Lane Management, and other Flexport.org teams on solutions that need internal alignment and creative problem\-solving.
* Mentor account teammates: share playbooks, join key partner calls, and help the team raise its game.
* Use AI\-enabled tools to automate and improve internal and partner\-facing processes where it makes the work faster or better.

**You Should Have**
-------------------


* 5\+ years in account management, business development, or a similar partner\-facing role. A background in logistics, supply chain, humanitarian aid, or international development is strongly preferred.
* A track record of independently managing and growing a complex, multi\-product book of business.
* Deep understanding of global trade and supply chain operations across multiple modes. You can speak fluently about ocean, air, trucking, and customs.
* Comfort operating without a playbook in ambiguous or novel situations, and the judgment to write the playbook for others once you've solved it.
* Strong commercial instincts: you spot growth opportunities before partners ask, and you close them.
* Genuine curiosity about the humanitarian and development space. You want to become an expert in aid logistics, not just move freight.
* A natural tendency to develop others. Peers and junior teammates get better from working alongside you.
* A compliance\-first mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and our partners and regulators need to trust us.

**You Will Get**
----------------


* Ownership of Flexport.org's most complex and meaningful partner relationships, the accounts where the impact is biggest.
* A visible role in shaping how the Flexport.org account team operates. Your judgment and approach set the standard.
* Opportunities to contribute to team playbooks, onboarding content, and process improvements.
* A front\-row seat on Flexport.org's mission: getting aid to the people who need it, on time.
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

#### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity**



At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


#### **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants**



Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

jobs.title: Account Manager - National & Franchise Accounts
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k) matching
* Bonus based on performance
* Company parties
* Free food \& snacks
* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* 401(k)
* Health insurance
  
  

**About us**
SpeedPro Windy City is a large\-format printing and signage studio in Downers Grove. We produce window graphics, wall murals, vehicle and fleet wraps, trade show displays, and signage for clients across Chicagoland and the nation. We are the ones behind the fleet of trucks you see everywhere, and we design, produce, and install the murals and graphics you see at businesses, universities, and sports arenas. We are a small team with big clients, and we are building the side of the business that serves brands with many locations.  


**About this role**
You own our multi\-location relationships: franchise systems, national brands with Chicago\-area sites, property groups, and the agencies that buy for them. These are program accounts. The same graphics package goes into twenty or two hundred locations, on a schedule, to a brand standard, with a purchase order and a certificate of insurance for every site. You are the person who makes that happen and who turns one location into the next forty.
This is a growth seat. You will service the accounts we have, but the job is measured on the accounts you build.
You do not need print experience. You need to have grown a book of business\-to\-business accounts and to like learning how things are made. We will teach you our materials, our methods, and our pricing.  


**What you will own**  


**Account growth**
* Grow existing national and franchise accounts: more locations, more product lines, longer agreements
* Prospect and land new program accounts: franchisors, multi\-location operators, brand and facilities managers, agencies
* Build the relationships that get us specified into brand standards, so the next location comes to us by default

**Program management**
* Scope, quote, and manage rollouts across many sites: site surveys, specs, proofs, production schedules, install windows, and close\-out
* Manage the paperwork that program accounts run on: vendor onboarding portals, purchase orders, certificates of insurance, W\-9s, net terms, and permits
* Coordinate with our office manager and production team so program work flows through the shop without disrupting local orders
* Keep every open program visible: what is approved, what is in production, what is installed, what is invoiced

**Client relationship**
* Be the single point of contact your accounts trust
* Run quarterly reviews with your top accounts; know their rollout calendar before they tell you
* Resolve issues fast and in writing. A missed install at one site cannot become a lost account

  

  

**What we are looking for**  


**Required**
* Three or more years in business\-to\-business account management, inside or outside sales, or client program management, with responsibility for growing revenue, not just servicing it
* Experience with multi\-location, franchise, or program accounts in any industry: uniforms, fixtures, facilities services, promotional products, packaging, point\-of\-purchase displays, commercial furniture, construction services, or similar
* Comfortable with specifications, dimensions, and production files. You will learn our materials and methods here; you need to be someone who likes learning how things are made
* Organized enough to run many concurrent orders across many sites without dropping one. You keep a system, and it is written down
* Clear, direct writer. Program accounts run on email and documentation
* Valid driver’s license. Local travel to client sites and installs
* Based in Downers Grove with flexibility for client visits

**Strong plus**
* Sign, print, graphics, trade show, or point\-of\-purchase industry experience
* Selling to or working inside a franchise system
* Agency\-side production or account experience
* CRM or order management systems. We use CoreBridge
* Familiarity with permits, certificates of insurance, and vendor compliance portals

  

  

**What this is not**
This is not a design seat, and it is not a phone\-bank sales job. It is relationship and program work with a technical product, for someone who wants to build a book of accounts that renews.  


**How to apply**
Send us your resume and, if you have one, a short note on the largest multi\-location account you have managed or grown. If it looks like a fit, we will set up a call.  


SpeedPro Windy City is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Enterprise Client Success
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**


We are currently hiring an **Enterprise Client Success**for our**Enterprise Delivery** **team**, and our ideal candidatewill possess a passion for impacting lives and our community. The primary purpose of this position is to serve as the primary local\-level liaison between Staffmark Group and assigned national account clients. This role bridges the strategic goals of the national account relationship with the day\-to\-day operational excellence required at the local market level. Client Success ensures consistent service delivery, workforce compliance, and high\-quality experience for both the client and placed associates.

**Essential Duties**

**Your Day\-to\-Day Leadership includes Activities such as these:**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships through regular on\-site visits, proactive communication, and responsive issue resolution.
* Participates in forecasting meetings and discussions with clients to identify current and future staffing needs.
* Works to identify and gather sales leads from candidate pool to share with sales team.
* Partner with recruiting teams to ensure timely and quality delivery against client headcount requirements.
* Monitor Talent attendance, performance, and retention; implement corrective actions in alignment with client and company standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve service delivery issues before they impact client satisfaction.
* Escalate systemic or complex issues to the National Account Manager with supporting data and recommended solutions.
* Conduct on\-site orientations, safety walk\-throughs, and check\-ins to support associate engagement and reduce attrition.

**Competencies**

* **Competencies we value for this role**
* Culture of Heart: Provides the tools, training, and resources to focus on the impact of being a part of the team to help each other succeed.
* Customer Service: Effectively interacts with and meets the needs of our customers to provide the best service and experience possible.
* Client Relationships: Builds, maintains, and strengthens relationships with internal and external clients.
* Data\-Driven: Uses data to understand impacts, implications, and makes data\-backed decisions to put resources where they are most impactful.
* Curiosity and Innovation: Demonstrates curiosity, develops new insights, considers creative approaches and applies novel solutions.
* Adaptability: Adapts quickly to change and easily considers new approaches.
* Communication: Uses effective written and oral communication with internal staff, teams, clients, talent, and communities served. Demonstrates empathy and listening.
* Detail\-Oriented: Meets deadlines and produce work with few to no errors. Organizes projects, understands teams, and creates detailed plans.
* Interpersonal Skills: Interacts positively with courtesy, sensitivity and respect with a variety of individuals and makes every effort to understand and relate to others.

**Culture**

**The Staffmark Group experience is more than just a job:**

* Opportunity. We are proud to be a part of RGF Staffing, a Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd., company – one of the largest staffing firms in the world. As an active contributor to the company, professional development and career advancement opportunities will be within your grasp!
* Award\-winning teamwork. We have earned industry\-leading recognition, such as *ClearlyRated’s* *Best of Staffing Client, Best of Staffing Talent, Best of Staffing Employer, and Best Staffing Firms for Women* Awards.

We strive to foster authentic belonging for all the lives we touch. We are committed to supporting the diversity of each of our employees, and celebrating the inclusion of all types of thought, differences, and voices. We celebrate our differences and capitalize on them to promote creativity and equality, and to help change our world for the better. Every individual who works with us will be treated with respect, without exception.
* An engaging culture. Do you do your best work when you are challenged, inspired, and having fun? Us too! That is why the tenure of our internal staff is well\-above the industry average.
* Excellent benefits. Our team’s health and life balance are important to us, so we offer competitive pay, cutting edge benefits, a generous Paid Time Off plan, and consistent recognition for a job well done.
* Training and support excellence. Bring your talent and commitment, and we'll provide the tools and resources you need to be successful on the job.

new_jobs.title: Global Aid Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Flexport:**
-------------------



At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.



The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------



Flexport.org is the humanitarian arm of Flexport. We serve nonprofits, NGOs, and mission\-driven organizations that need to move impactful cargo reliably, often into some of the hardest environments to reach. As humanitarian and development needs keep climbing, the supply chain expertise our partners can count on matters more than ever.



You'll own some of Flexport.org's most complex and highest\-impact partner relationships. Your accounts span multiple shipping modes and trade lanes: ocean, air, trucking, and customs, and demand real supply chain fluency to navigate well. You won't just manage these relationships, you'll shape them. You bring a strategic point of view to every partner engagement, lead business reviews that drive real decisions, and connect the dots across Flexport's full product suite to help partners do more with what they have. You'll operate with full autonomy, hold a high bar on program growth and retention, and become someone junior teammates turn to for guidance.


**You Will**
------------


* Own end\-to\-end success for a portfolio of complex, multi\-modal Flexport.org partner accounts, including partners with significant program growth potential and high operational intensity.
* Lead RFP bids and contract renewals end\-to\-end.
* Serve as a true strategic partner to nonprofits, NGOs, and mission\-driven organizations, going deep on their supply chain operations to find where Flexport can cut cost, add capability, or move faster.
* Lead high\-impact business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) that go beyond reporting. Bring market context, multi\-modal insight, and recommendations tailored to each partner's mission and constraints.
* Drive expansion across Flexport's full product suite, consistently meeting or exceeding program growth and retention targets.
* Collaborate with Operations, Pricing, Legal, Trade Lane Management, and other Flexport.org teams on solutions that need internal alignment and creative problem\-solving.
* Mentor account teammates: share playbooks, join key partner calls, and help the team raise its game.
* Use AI\-enabled tools to automate and improve internal and partner\-facing processes where it makes the work faster or better.

**You Should Have**
-------------------


* 5\+ years in account management, business development, or a similar partner\-facing role. A background in logistics, supply chain, humanitarian aid, or international development is strongly preferred.
* A track record of independently managing and growing a complex, multi\-product book of business.
* Deep understanding of global trade and supply chain operations across multiple modes. You can speak fluently about ocean, air, trucking, and customs.
* Comfort operating without a playbook in ambiguous or novel situations, and the judgment to write the playbook for others once you've solved it.
* Strong commercial instincts: you spot growth opportunities before partners ask, and you close them.
* Genuine curiosity about the humanitarian and development space. You want to become an expert in aid logistics, not just move freight.
* A natural tendency to develop others. Peers and junior teammates get better from working alongside you.
* A compliance\-first mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and our partners and regulators need to trust us.

**You Will Get**
----------------


* Ownership of Flexport.org's most complex and meaningful partner relationships, the accounts where the impact is biggest.
* A visible role in shaping how the Flexport.org account team operates. Your judgment and approach set the standard.
* Opportunities to contribute to team playbooks, onboarding content, and process improvements.
* A front\-row seat on Flexport.org's mission: getting aid to the people who need it, on time.
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

#### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity**



At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


#### **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants**



Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager - National & Franchise Accounts
new_jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k) matching
* Bonus based on performance
* Company parties
* Free food \& snacks
* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* 401(k)
* Health insurance
  
  

**About us**
SpeedPro Windy City is a large\-format printing and signage studio in Downers Grove. We produce window graphics, wall murals, vehicle and fleet wraps, trade show displays, and signage for clients across Chicagoland and the nation. We are the ones behind the fleet of trucks you see everywhere, and we design, produce, and install the murals and graphics you see at businesses, universities, and sports arenas. We are a small team with big clients, and we are building the side of the business that serves brands with many locations.  


**About this role**
You own our multi\-location relationships: franchise systems, national brands with Chicago\-area sites, property groups, and the agencies that buy for them. These are program accounts. The same graphics package goes into twenty or two hundred locations, on a schedule, to a brand standard, with a purchase order and a certificate of insurance for every site. You are the person who makes that happen and who turns one location into the next forty.
This is a growth seat. You will service the accounts we have, but the job is measured on the accounts you build.
You do not need print experience. You need to have grown a book of business\-to\-business accounts and to like learning how things are made. We will teach you our materials, our methods, and our pricing.  


**What you will own**  


**Account growth**
* Grow existing national and franchise accounts: more locations, more product lines, longer agreements
* Prospect and land new program accounts: franchisors, multi\-location operators, brand and facilities managers, agencies
* Build the relationships that get us specified into brand standards, so the next location comes to us by default

**Program management**
* Scope, quote, and manage rollouts across many sites: site surveys, specs, proofs, production schedules, install windows, and close\-out
* Manage the paperwork that program accounts run on: vendor onboarding portals, purchase orders, certificates of insurance, W\-9s, net terms, and permits
* Coordinate with our office manager and production team so program work flows through the shop without disrupting local orders
* Keep every open program visible: what is approved, what is in production, what is installed, what is invoiced

**Client relationship**
* Be the single point of contact your accounts trust
* Run quarterly reviews with your top accounts; know their rollout calendar before they tell you
* Resolve issues fast and in writing. A missed install at one site cannot become a lost account

  

  

**What we are looking for**  


**Required**
* Three or more years in business\-to\-business account management, inside or outside sales, or client program management, with responsibility for growing revenue, not just servicing it
* Experience with multi\-location, franchise, or program accounts in any industry: uniforms, fixtures, facilities services, promotional products, packaging, point\-of\-purchase displays, commercial furniture, construction services, or similar
* Comfortable with specifications, dimensions, and production files. You will learn our materials and methods here; you need to be someone who likes learning how things are made
* Organized enough to run many concurrent orders across many sites without dropping one. You keep a system, and it is written down
* Clear, direct writer. Program accounts run on email and documentation
* Valid driver’s license. Local travel to client sites and installs
* Based in Downers Grove with flexibility for client visits

**Strong plus**
* Sign, print, graphics, trade show, or point\-of\-purchase industry experience
* Selling to or working inside a franchise system
* Agency\-side production or account experience
* CRM or order management systems. We use CoreBridge
* Familiarity with permits, certificates of insurance, and vendor compliance portals

  

  

**What this is not**
This is not a design seat, and it is not a phone\-bank sales job. It is relationship and program work with a technical product, for someone who wants to build a book of accounts that renews.  


**How to apply**
Send us your resume and, if you have one, a short note on the largest multi\-location account you have managed or grown. If it looks like a fit, we will set up a call.  


SpeedPro Windy City is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
